title: Tiny, cute yo-yo
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- string -->
  <path d='M50 18 Q48 28 50 36' stroke='#f2d27e' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- string curl -->
  <path d='M50 18 Q54 14 58 16 Q60 18 57 19' stroke='#f2d27e' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- top disc shadow/edge -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='22' ry='8' fill='#b33a3a'/>
  <!-- top disc -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='22' ry='8' fill='#e85050'/>
  <!-- top disc highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='38' rx='9' ry='3' fill='#ff8a8a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- axle body -->
  <rect x='38' y='44' width='24' height='20' rx='5' fill='#3a7bd5'/>
  <!-- axle shine -->
  <rect x='44' y='46' width='5' height='16' rx='2.5' fill='#6aa8f0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- bottom disc edge -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='22' ry='8' fill='#7a2020'/>
  <!-- bottom disc -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='22' ry='8' fill='#d94040'/>
  <!-- bottom disc highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='62' rx='9' ry='3' fill='#ff9a9a' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- cute eyes on top disc -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='40' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='40' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='41' r='1.5' fill='#3a7bd5'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='41' r='1.5' fill='#3a7bd5'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='39' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='39' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M46 44 Q50 47 54 44' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='43' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#ffb3b3' opacity='0.8'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='43' rx='3' ry='1.8' fill='#ffb3b3' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
